messages:
diane (product): Heads-up: we're standardizing a parameter rename across SDKs in the next minor release to improve clarity: `model_id` -> `engine`. This will be backwards-compatible for one release cycle but we need docs and samples updated. Please read the plan and flag any concerns.

omar (eng): What's the compatibility approach? breaking rename in patch would be rough for users.

diane (product): Plan: ship SDK v4.2 with both params accepted (`model_id` still works but emits a deprecation warning). v4.3 will remove `model_id` entirely. That's ~6 weeks between announcements.

rita (docs): I'll run a repo search for `model_id` usage in docs and samples and prepare a staged PR set to update examples to `engine`. ETA: 5 business days for initial PRs.

leo (devex): I'll add an adapter shim in the samples repo so automated examples keep working during the transition. Also will publish a short migration snippet: `response = client.generate(engine="gpt-large")` and a codemod for common JS/TS patterns.

omar (eng): We'll add a runtime deprecation warning when `model_id` is used and emit a single aggregated telemetry event per org (opt-outable). No request bodies logged.

diane (product): Good. Also adding a small compatibility note for Dedicated/Private: we'll support `model_id` for 12 months for on-prem packs via a compatibility layer; customers can request extended timelines.

rita (docs): Banner text draft: "Deprecation: `model_id` parameter will be removed in v4.3. Use `engine` instead. See migration guide." Thoughts?

omar (eng): Sounds good. Add a tiny mapping table in the migration guide showing common values and any renames (e.g., `gpt-3-lite` -> `gpt-small` if applicable).

leo (devex): Codemod plan: JS/TS jscodeshift + Python libcst. Will publish the codemod repo and a GH Action to run on sample repos. Beta in 2 weeks.

diane (product): Action items:
- docs: search & PRs to update samples (rita) 
- devex: shim + codemod (leo)
- eng: runtime warning + telemetry (omar)
- product: customer comms + FAQ (diane)
Target timeline: announcement today, v4.2 (dual param) in 2 weeks, v4.3 (remove `model_id`) in ~8 weeks.

ci-bot: Created task: docs-update-modelparam-1829991234 assigned to rita.

diane (product): If any team needs a longer runway, please ping me directly. We'll coordinate exceptions for private deployments. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
